# Manual wallpaper fixtures

These images were added for visual theming experiments in commit `4d1a77d`
(2026-11-04, "add wallpapers for make test"), not generated by automated tests.
Commit `879f27d` renamed them without changing their contents:

| Original name | Fixture name | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wallpaper2.jpg` | `wallpaper_for_test.jpg` | `87ba06cc0614fa328c47b57249132df5836ade365dfdc7d4525aec6693a08019` |
| `wallpaper3.png` | `rally_car.png` | `486f83884dc5172a9e9dc959f9b0925135bbce6aaac7923ace45db25a2e9f6eb` |

They are retained unchanged for manual comparison and the regression proving
that test-only images never enter installation payloads. They are not declared
shipping wallpapers. Automated colour-quality tests still generate their own
tiny deterministic images; these files are not needed for extraction at login.

Product wallpapers must be explicitly reviewed and listed in
`common/assets/wallpapers.json`; dropping a file into `common/wallpapers/` alone
does not authorize deployment.
